extras.price_arithmetic: USD 0.12 a browser hour x 300 h = 36, but the 100 included hours cover the first 100, so 300 h = 24
extras.price_note: 300 browser hours on Developer: USD 20 plan includes 100 hours, then USD 0.12 an hour, so 20 + 200(0.12) = 44.00. 730 hours: 20 + 630(0.12) = 95.60. The browser hour is not a vCPU shape, so this row is not comparable with a sandbox row.
extras.price_basis: 300 and 730 BROWSER HOURS, not a 2 vCPU shape. A browser host sells minutes of a remote browser, so these rows are not comparable with a sandbox row.
